source.citation: h = g t² / 8: rise against air time for ballistic flight with equal takeoff and landing height
source.notes: Checks the implementation, not reality. h is the peak centre-of-mass height above its takeoff value, t runs from the takeoff tick to the landing tick; both are camera-visible quantities, not JumpResult fields. The band allows the tick quantization of t. jumpMode 2 with movesMode 1, so part of the lift comes from approach speed (jumpSpeedShare); flight must still be ballistic.
